events.verdict: Mitchell (MIA) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Harden's (LAC) face during the steal attempt.
Wiggins (MIA) and Leonard (LAC) briefly engage and disengage as they navigate the screen, and the contact is marginal.
Zubac (LAC) is already in Wiggins' (MIA) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) is already in Powell's (MIA) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Powell (MIA) and Zubac (LAC) briefly engage and disengage as they position themselves off-ball in the post.  Powell then cleanly deflects the post entry pass away from Zubac.
Zubac (LAC) initiates body contact with Adebayo (MIA) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Powell (MIA) places his arm momentarily on Jones Jr.'s (LAC) upper body and immediately removes it as marginal contact occurs during the inbound.
Wiggins (MIA) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) is moving alongside Adebayo's (MIA) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Leonard (LAC) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Adebayo's (MIA) right leg extends out as part of his natural shooting motion, and the contact with Zubac (LAC) as he releases the jump shot attempt is marginal.
Harden (LAC) is bracing for the contact from Powell (LAC) as they come together on the perimeter, and the contact as Harden releases away into his shot attempt is marginal.

Powell (MIA) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt. Harden extends his right leg out after releasing the shot attempt to create any marginal contact with Powell's leg as he returns to the ground.
Zubac (LAC) brings both hands to the ball to tie up Powell (MIA), and the contact with Powell's arm before the ball is tied up is deemed marginal.  A jump ball is correctly called on this play.
Larsson (MIA) and Harden (LAC) mutually engage and disengage during the jump ball.
Powell (MIA) and Jones Jr. (LAC) briefly engage and disengage and the contact between the two players is marginal.
Jones Jr. (LAC) is already in Wiggins' (MIA) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Powell (MIA) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
